name: Chancroid
advice: Avoid sex until ulcers heal and partners (last 10 days) are treated. Tests: VDRL/TPHA, HIV and HSV PCR if available; repeat syphilis and HIV serology at 3 months. A soft, fluctuant groin node should be needle-aspirated in clinic, not cut open.

ref: Wolverton 4e ch 9; CDC STI 2021; NACO STI technical guidelines

rx.instr: IM; Alternative to azithromycin (e.g. in pregnancy)
